female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

female-child-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who list the specific ages of their children fund faster.
female-child-age-faster.body: Providing precise ages for children in the pitch text is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-boilerplate-slower.title: Female borrowers who use generic template language fund more slowly.
female-boilerplate-slower.body: Pitches from women that utilize generic template language, such as standard greetings or boilerplate phrasing about inspiring others, are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-married-status-slower.title: Female borrowers who identify as married in their pitch text fund more slowly.
female-married-status-slower.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state their marital status as married are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-community-contribution-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention contributing to the community or social causes fund faster.
female-community-contribution-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight benefits to the broader community or social causes are associated with increased funding speed.

female-character-traits-slower.title: Female borrowers who emphasize internal character traits like dedication or commitment fund more slowly.
female-character-traits-slower.body: Pitches from women that focus on internal virtues, such as being hardworking, dedicated, or committed, are associated with slower funding speeds.

male-credentials-slower.body: Male borrowers who emphasize formal academic degrees or professional credentials may fund more slowly.

family-specificity-general.body: Providing specific details about family members may accelerate funding regardless of gender.

female-aspirational-language-slower.body: Female borrowers who use aspirational words like 'dream' to describe goals may fund more slowly.

female-children-future-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention children's educational needs or a better future for children may fund faster.

female-loan-details-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific loan amounts in local currency or the lending institution may fund more slowly.

female-shorter-pitch-faster.body: Female borrowers who write significantly shorter pitches may fund faster.

female-repayment-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention their history of repaying previous loans may fund faster.

female-training-org-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific training organizations may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include explicit gratitude markers to Kiva or lenders may fund more slowly.

female-operational-detail-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of their physical environment or daily operational routine may fund more slowly.

female-institutional-boilerplate-faster.title: Female borrowers who include specific institutional boilerplate (e.g., BRAC) may fund faster.
female-institutional-boilerplate-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for new puzzles.

female-supplies-slower.title: Pitches from women that specify particular inputs, such as certified seeds or fertilizers, are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-supplies-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap upon promotion of female-married-status-slower.

female-schooling-mention-slower.title: Pitches from women that emphasize funding for children's education or school fees are associated with slower funding speeds compared to professional goals.
female-schooling-mention-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap upon promotion of female-community-contribution-faster.

female-asset-ownership-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention asset ownership, such as owning a home, may fund faster.
female-asset-ownership-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific physical assets like freezers or plots correlate with slower funding.

female-long-term-pressure-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention long-term financial pressures, such as college costs, may fund slower.
female-long-term-pressure-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that educational needs and a better future for children accelerate funding for women.

female-struggle-mention-faster.title: Pitches from women that identify specific risks, health hazards, or business struggles tend to accelerate funding speed.
female-struggle-mention-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that personal hardship and narrative correlate with slower funding for women.

female-demographic-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed personal demographic information may fund more slowly.
female-demographic-specificity-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new puzzle.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who include a direct thank you to lenders may fund faster.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that gratitude and claims of being deserving correlate with slower funding.

female-physical-assets-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific physical assets, such as equipment or land, may fund more slowly.
female-physical-assets-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that identifying specific equipment (smartphone) accelerates funding for women.

female-narrative-hardship-slower.title: Pitches from women that focus on personal stories of hardship or narrative-driven appeals are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-narrative-hardship-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap upon promotion of female-character-traits-slower.
